notes.content: No courses are required for admission to Seaver College. Completion of any amount of the following will help satisfy general education requirements at Seaver College. For courses with no articulations listed, credit(s) may be reviewed on a case by case basis, and students can petition for reevaluation of transfer credit upon enrollment at Seaver College. Only courses with grades of C (2.000) or higher may transfer to fulfill requirements at Seaver College. Courses transferred into Seaver College may receive unit credit, but will not contribute toward a student's cumulative GPA. Any course taken on a quarter system will be converted to semester units. Up to a maximum of 64 units may be transferred for credit to Seaver College. Students who transfer with 30 or more units will be exempt from the first-year, Foundations of Reasoning requirement.
